title: Self-service draft erasure is silently undone by any still-open form tab (no post-erasure tombstone on re-save)
evidence:
delete_draft_by_token.sql: "DELETE FROM application_draft d
USING vacancy v
WHERE d.continue_token = $1
  AND d.vacancy_id = v.id
  AND v.short_code = $2
RETURNING d.id::text;" — hard delete, no tombstone. upsert_application_draft.sql: "INSERT INTO application_draft (vacancy_id, email, fields)
VALUES ($1::uuid, lower($2), $3::jsonb)
ON CONFLICT (vacancy_id, email) DO UPDATE
  SET fields = EXCLUDED.fields,
      updated_at = now()
  WHERE application_draft.submitted_at IS NULL
RETURNING id::text;" — the only resurrection guard is the submitted_at tombstone left by strip_draft_on_submit. form_draft.js:227-234: pagehide handler still fires navigator.sendBeacon(draftUrl, ...) and the debounced saver stays armed; saverDisabled is only set on the closed-vacancy arm (line 211), never on erasure.
detail: Applicant opens the continue email (e.g. on phone), deletes the draft, sees 'has been deleted'; their laptop tab with the form still open then step-saves or pagehide-beacons, and the upsert re-INSERTs the full PII payload because erasure left no tombstone row for the WHERE clause to reject. The diff explicitly guarded this exact vector for submit (submitted_at tombstone, comment names the beacon) but not for erasure.
recommended_fix: Make erasure a tombstone (e.g. soft-delete flag / set fields='{}' plus an erased_at stamp that upsert's WHERE rejects, swept later by retention) instead of a hard DELETE, or have the save endpoint refuse writes for erased (vacancy,email) pairs.
